# Entity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Entity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Anything in the GMEOW universe of discourse that persists in time and can bear properties: an agent, a document, a contact point, and so on.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Endurant`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Endurant)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Endurant`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Endurant). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the universal domain when a property, facet, or claim must attach to anything that persists and can bear properties — the anchor for the domain-free facets (granularity, determinacy, sensitivity, consumer eligibility) that are defined Entity-wide.

### Avoid when

- Avoid typing an instance as a bare [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) when a more specific sortal applies; reserve the unqualified type for genuinely category-neutral resources, and never use it for occurrents (those are [gufo:Event](../../external/terms.md#gufo-event), not endurants).

### How to use

- Type each instance with its most specific sortal ([`Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md), [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`PhysicalObject`](gmeow-PhysicalObject.md), [`SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)) and let it inherit [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md); attach the universal facets here because they range over the whole sortal spine.

### Examples

- ex:thing a [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md); [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](../properties/gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) [`gmeow:sensitivityPublic`](../individuals/gmeow-sensitivityPublic.md); [`gmeow:hasGranularity`](../properties/gmeow-hasGranularity.md) ex:cityLevel.
